about: Lab PR 246, the KVM failure of 27/10/2026 (job 122036206565): a shell connects to a network canary on a loopback port nothing listens on, the trip (NN-L-CANARY-003), and closes the refused socket at once. The flow tracker read the close before the connect and synthesised its row (tcp 127.0.0.1:0, the port the kernel cleared), which started at the close: it reached the engine after the trip under another key and drew NN-L-CHAIN-003 on the trip's own connection. The row now starts at the connect (the kernel correlator's time), the trip owns its connection in the flow ledger: the close draws nothing, nor does the connect-time row arriving after it (a full bus). A later flow of the shell to another host is an egress after the trip: NN-L-CHAIN-003.
